table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	NTNo=C.NTNNo,
	STRNO=C.SalestaxRegNo,
	AliasName = A.AliasName,
	Customer = A.Name,
	SaleInvCode = S.SaleInvCode,
	RefNo = S.CustRefNo,
	Date = S.Date,
	Rate = MAX(D.GSTPerc),
	Qty = SUM(D.LooseQty + D.BonusQty),
	Weight = SUM((D.LooseQty + D.BonusQty) * I.UnitWeight),
	ValueExTax = SUM(D.LooseQty * (D.SalePrice - D.ItemFlatDisc) * (1 - D.DiscPerc * 0.01)),
	SalesTax = ROUND(SUM(D.LooseQty * (D.SalePrice - D.ItemFlatDisc) * (1 - D.DiscPerc * 0.01) * D.GSTPerc * 0.01), 2),
	ExtraTaxPerc = (SUM((D.LooseQty + D.Bonusqty) * D.UnitSalesTax) / CASE WHEN SUM(D.LooseQty * (D.SalePrice - D.ItemFlatDisc) * (1 - D.DiscPerc * 0.01)) > 0 THEN SUM(D.LooseQty * (D.SalePrice - D.ItemFlatDisc) * (1 - D.DiscPerc * 0.01)) ELSE 1 END) * 100,
	ExtraTax = SUM((D.LooseQty + D.Bonusqty) * D.UnitSalesTax),
	ItemAdvanceTax = SUM(ROUND(
		(((D.PackQty + D.LooseQty) * (D.SalePrice - D.ItemFlatDisc) * (1 - D.DiscPerc * 0.01)) + 
		((D.PackQty + D.LooseQty + D.BonusQty) * (D.SalePrice - D.ItemFlatDisc) * (1 - D.DiscPerc * 0.01) * D.Gstperc * 0.01) +
		((D.PackQty + D.LooseQty + D.BonusQty) * D.UnitSalesTax)) * D.ItemAdvanceTaxPerc * 0.01, 2))
FROM 
	SaleLedger S, SaleDetail D, Customer C, Accounts A, Item I, CustomerCategory CC
WHERE
	S.Posted='Y' AND
	S.Date BETWEEN :adt_startdate AND :adt_enddate AND
	S.SaleInvcode = D.SaleInvCode AND
	S.CustCode = C.CustCode AND
	C.CustCode = A.AccCode AND
	C.CustCatCode = CC.CustCatCode AND
	CC.CustCatCode IN (:ai_custcatcode) AND
	D.ICode = I.ICode 
GROUP BY
	C.NTNNo,
	C.SalestaxRegNo,
	A.AliasName,
	A.Name,
	S.CustRefNo,
	S.SaleInvCode,
	S.Date
UNION ALL
SELECT 
	NTNo=C.NTNNo,
	STRNO=C.SalestaxRegNo,
	AliasName = A.AliasName,
	Customer = A.Name,
	SaleInvCode = S.SaleInvCode,
	RefNo = S.CustRefNo,
	Date = S.Date,
	Rate = MAX(D.GSTPerc),
	Qty = SUM(D.LooseQty + D.BonusQty),
	Weight = SUM((D.LooseQty + D.BonusQty) * I.UnitWeight),
	ValueExTax = SUM(D.LooseQty * (D.SalePrice - D.ItemFlatDisc) * (1 - D.DiscPerc * 0.01)),
	SalesTax = ROUND(SUM(D.LooseQty * (D.SalePrice - D.ItemFlatDisc) * (1 - D.DiscPerc * 0.01) * D.GSTPerc * 0.01), 2),
	ExtraTaxPerc = (SUM((D.LooseQty + D.Bonusqty) * D.UnitSalesTax) / CASE WHEN SUM(D.LooseQty * (D.SalePrice - D.ItemFlatDisc) * (1 - D.DiscPerc * 0.01)) > 0 THEN SUM(D.LooseQty * (D.SalePrice - D.ItemFlatDisc) * (1 - D.DiscPerc * 0.01)) ELSE 1 END) * 100,
	ExtraTax = SUM((D.LooseQty + D.Bonusqty) * D.UnitSalesTax),
	ItemAdvanceTax = SUM(ROUND(
		(((D.PackQty + D.LooseQty) * (D.SalePrice - D.ItemFlatDisc) * (1 - D.DiscPerc * 0.01)) + 
		((D.PackQty + D.LooseQty + D.BonusQty) * (D.SalePrice - D.ItemFlatDisc) * (1 - D.DiscPerc * 0.01) * D.Gstperc * 0.01) +
		((D.PackQty + D.LooseQty + D.BonusQty) * D.UnitSalesTax)) * D.ItemAdvanceTaxPerc * 0.01, 2))
FROM 
	CRS_SaleLedger S, CRS_SaleDetail D, Customer C, Accounts A, Item I, CustomerCategory CC
WHERE
	S.ClientInstanceID = D.ClientInstanceID AND
	S.Posted='Y' AND
	S.Date BETWEEN :adt_startdate AND :adt_enddate AND
	S.SaleInvcode = D.SaleInvCode AND
	S.CustCode = C.CustCode AND
	C.CustCode = A.AccCode AND
	C.CustCatCode = CC.CustCatCode AND
	CC.CustCatCode IN (:ai_custcatcode) AND
	D.ICode = I.ICode 
GROUP BY
	S.ClientInstanceID,
	C.NTNNo,
	C.SalestaxRegNo,
	A.AliasName,
	A.Name,
	S.CustRefNo,
	S.SaleInvCode,
	S.Date
